notebooks.title: Compositional Heredity and Thermodynamic Persistence in Prebiotic Networks
notebooks.summary: This revision synthesizes findings on how non-templated autocatalytic networks achieve stable heritable compositional states. It clarifies that such heredity can emerge from growth-division cycles in multistable reaction networks rather than relying exclusively on template replication.
notebooks.findings:
Non-templated autocatalytic networks can manifest stable, heritable compositional states through growth and division cycles. [peer-e42e501e4ac1a9067d478914]

Composition operations in autocatalytic sets modulate long-term emergent behaviors, enabling tunable compositional stability. [peer-ed48aecf7ae9a74103715589]
notebooks.limitations: Findings are based on theoretical models and stochastic simulations; experimental verification in complex biopolymer contexts remains a critical gap.
notebooks.next_questions: What are the precise kinetic conditions or bifurcation points that separate mere 'persistence' (steady state) from 'hereditary storage' (state retention across division)?

detail.title: Compositional Heredity and Thermodynamic Persistence in Prebiotic Networks
detail.summary: This revision synthesizes findings on how non-templated autocatalytic networks achieve stable heritable compositional states. It clarifies that such heredity can emerge from growth-division cycles in multistable reaction networks rather than relying exclusively on template replication.
detail.findings:
Non-templated autocatalytic networks can manifest stable, heritable compositional states through growth and division cycles. [peer-e42e501e4ac1a9067d478914]

Composition operations in autocatalytic sets modulate long-term emergent behaviors, enabling tunable compositional stability. [peer-ed48aecf7ae9a74103715589]
detail.limitations: Findings are based on theoretical models and stochastic simulations; experimental verification in complex biopolymer contexts remains a critical gap.
detail.next_questions: What are the precise kinetic conditions or bifurcation points that separate mere 'persistence' (steady state) from 'hereditary storage' (state retention across division)?
detail.reason: Updating notebook findings based on new evidence regarding composition operations and protocell division models.
